###### Proposal

# Simple Summary

## Compound V2 Deprecation Proposal

- Pause borrows and mints for all assets on Compound V2
- Increase Reserve Factors to 100% for all assets on Compound v2

**Note**: In response to community feedback, Gauntlet has recommended adding USDC & USDT as collaterals on Mainnet WETH & WBTC. The Mainnet WETH listing has already gone on-chain ([Tally](https://www.tally.xyz/gov/compound/proposal/501?govId=eip155:1:0x309a862bbC1A00e45506cB8A802D1ff10004c8C0)). The Mainnet WBTC listing will be proposed later this week.

## Motivation

Full proposals and forum discussions can be found in the following post.

- [[Gauntlet] Compound V2 Deprecation Proposal](https://www.comp.xyz/t/gauntlet-compound-v2-deprecation-proposal/7237 "[Gauntlet] Compound V2 Deprecation Proposal")

## Specification

The proposal updates the parameters by using the respective methods on the Configurator.

By approving this proposal, you agree that any services provided by Gauntlet shall be governed by the terms of service available at gauntlet.xyz/tos

foundationConfirmation.author: Compound_Foundation
excerpts: Pausing new borrows and mints across v2 markets while allowing withdrawals, repayments, and liquidations to continue.
While residual user positions continue to close over time, the associated protocol reserves are no longer actively deployed for market operations and instead remain latent.
foundationConfirmation.qualification: This follow-up confirms the earlier executed lifecycle decision. Its separate proposed reserve-management mandate is not presented as executed or as the retirement transaction.

historicalOfficialMap.qualification: Historical official address attribution, not a current active-market list. Excludes delegate implementations and Compound III cUSDCv3. cWBTC and cWBTC2 are distinct addresses. The retirement decision is protocol-wide; no claim that proposal512 separately emitted an update for every historical address or that current delegate implementation ABIs were retrieved.

maintainedDocumentationIsNotLifecycleApp.observedText: the codebase is open-source, and maintained by the community
maintainedDocumentationIsNotLifecycleApp.qualification: Accessible V2 documentation, a maintained code repository, historical address maps, residual repayments/withdrawals and remaining reward claims do not override the executed deployment wind-down or the repository no-exit-exception policy.
